mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_request ( EMP_ID, REASON, LEAVE_TYPE, STATUS, START_DT, END_DT ) VALUES( #{employeeId}, #{reason}, #{leaveType}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT EMP_ID AS employeeId, REASON AS reason, LEAVE_TYPE AS leaveType, STATUS AS status, START_DT AS startDate, END_DT AS endDate FROM leave_request WHERE EMP_ID = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_balance ( EMP_ID, MONTH, YEAR, LEAVE_BALANCE, LEAVE_TYPE, TOTAL_LEAVE, USED, REMAINING ) VALUES( #{employeeId}, #{month}, #{year}, #{leaveBalance}, #{leaveType}, #{totalLeave}, #{usedLeave}, #{reminingLeave} )
